t: 威廉·巴伦茨和雅各布·范·海姆斯克克发现了"熊岛".
te: Willem Barents and Jacob van Heemskerk discover Bear Island.
dz: 威廉·巴伦茨和雅各布·范·海姆斯克克发现了"熊岛".
de: Willem Barents and Jacob van Heemskerk discover Bear Island.

t: 荷兰探险家Willem Barentsz发现了北极群岛斯皮茨贝根.
te: The Dutch explorer Willem Barentsz discovers the Arctic archipelago of Spitsbergen.
dz: 荷兰探险家Willem Barentsz发现了北极群岛斯皮茨贝根.
de: The Dutch explorer Willem Barentsz discovers the Arctic archipelago of Spitsbergen.

t: 英荷军队在次日出走前将西班牙城市卡迪兹解雇.
te: English and Dutch troops sack the Spanish city of Cádiz before leaving the next day.
dz: 盎格鲁-西班牙战争:英荷军队在次日出走前将西班牙城市卡迪兹解雇.
de: Anglo-Spanish War: English and Dutch troops sack the Spanish city of Cádiz before leaving the next day.

t: 西班牙"圣费利佩"号轮船在日本海岸搁浅,其货物被地方当局没收.
te: The Spanish ship San Felipe runs aground on the coast of Japan and its cargo is confiscated by local authorities.
dz: 西班牙"圣费利佩"号轮船在日本海岸搁浅,其货物被地方当局没收.
de: The Spanish ship San Felipe runs aground on the coast of Japan and its cargo is confiscated by local authorities.

t: 第二艘西班牙军舰起航向英格兰出击,但被菲尼斯特尔角一带的风暴所击倒,迫使撤退到港口.
te: The second Spanish armada sets sail to strike against England, but is smashed by storms off Cape Finisterre forcing a r…
dz: 第二艘西班牙军舰起航向英格兰出击,但被菲尼斯特尔角一带的风暴所击倒,迫使撤退到港口.
de: The second Spanish armada sets sail to strike against England, but is smashed by storms off Cape Finisterre forcing a retreat to port.

dz: 克吉尔战争始于芬兰(当时为瑞典的一部分),当时农民反抗贵族征收的税.
de: The Cudgel War begins in Finland (at the time part of Sweden), when peasants rebel against the imposition of taxes by the nobility.
